title: Body Confident
greet: Hey, it's Lensy. 🪞 The internet is full of filters and 'rules' about how you should look. Let's spot what's fake and remember your worth was never your looks.

badge.title: Body Confident! 🪞
badge.blurb: You can spot a filter, bust the beauty myths (including colourism), care for your body instead of 'fixing' it, and untie your worth from your looks. 💎

helpLine: If worries about your body or eating fill your days, talk to someone you trust, like a parent, teacher or doctor, or call Childline, one-zero-nine-eight.
reassure: A hard body day is a day, not a verdict, and it passes. If heavy body or eating worries stick around, reach out to a trusted adult, counsellor or doctor. 💛

scenarios.hook: "Everyone should finish puberty at the same time."

myth.un: There's a 'right' time to be done with puberty.
myth.re: Bodies change on their own timetable; early and late are both normal.
myth.why: Puberty has a wide normal range.

scenarios.relearn: Bodies grow on their own schedule; there's no 'behind'.

scenarios.hook: "Acne means you're dirty or doing something wrong."

myth.un: Acne means you're unclean or bad.
myth.re: Acne is a normal hormonal part of puberty, not a hygiene fault.
myth.why: Hormones, not dirt, drive most teen acne.

scenarios.relearn: Acne is normal puberty, not a sign you're dirty.

scenarios.hook: "Periods should be hidden and never talked about."

myth.un: Periods are shameful and must be hidden.
myth.re: Menstruation is a normal, healthy body process you can manage with dignity.
myth.why: Stigma, not periods, is the problem.

scenarios.relearn: Periods are normal and healthy; manage them with dignity, no shame.

scenarios.hook: "Wet dreams or getting aroused means something's wrong with me."

myth.un: Wet dreams or arousal are signs something's wrong.
myth.re: They're a normal, expected part of a maturing body.
myth.why: This is healthy development, not a fault.

scenarios.relearn: Wet dreams and arousal are a normal part of growing up.

scenarios.hook: "A deeper voice or body hair means I should already look 'grown'."

myth.un: Once changes start, I should instantly look fully grown.
myth.re: Changes arrive gradually and unevenly, that's how it works.
myth.why: Development is a slow, uneven process.

scenarios.relearn: Puberty changes come gradually and unevenly; that's normal.

scenarios.relearn: Your worth has nothing to do with your skin tone.

myth.un: I'd be worth more to people if my skin were fairer.
myth.re: Your worth isn't a skin tone; the people who matter don't rank it.
myth.why: Colourism is a sold prejudice, not a truth about you.

scenarios.relearn: Someone else's looks don't shrink your worth.

myth.un: People who look better than me are worth more than me.
myth.re: Looks don't rank people; everyone's worth stands on its own.
myth.why: Worth isn't a contest your mirror decides.

scenarios.relearn: A bad mirror day doesn't change who you are.

myth.un: If I hate my reflection, my whole day is ruined.
myth.re: A mirror shows a surface; it can't tell you your worth.
myth.why: How you look isn't who you are.

scenarios.relearn: You don't have to earn worth by looking a certain way.
scenarios.hook: "I have to look good to deserve good things."

myth.un: I must look a certain way to deserve good things.
myth.re: You deserve good things as you are; looks aren't an entry fee.
myth.why: Worth isn't something a body earns.

scenarios.relearn: Your height has nothing to do with your value.
scenarios.hook: "Short guys just don't count as much."

myth.un: Short guys matter less than tall ones.
myth.re: Height is a number, not a measure of the man you are.
myth.why: No one worth knowing ranks you by inches.

scenarios.relearn: You are not 'less' while your body is changing.

myth.re: A changing body is doing its job; your worth never paused.
myth.why: Growth isn't a discount on you.

scenarios.relearn: Hating a body part doesn't make it your enemy.

myth.why: A body is for living in, not auditing.

scenarios.relearn: You're not behind because a stranger has bigger arms.

myth.un: Everyone fitter than me is just ahead of me as a person.
myth.re: A bigger arm isn't a better life; you're not in a race.
myth.why: Your value isn't measured against strangers.

scenarios.relearn: A relative's comment isn't a verdict on you.
